title: AI-Based eXtended Reality Training for Automation
summary: BSD design proposes AI-supported extended-reality training to improve workers' automation skills. Learning, production, and onboarding outcomes are not reported.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: BSD design proposes AI-supported extended-reality training to improve workers' automation skills. Learning, production, and onboarding outcomes are not reported. Training product development.
purpose: Help industrial workers acquire skills for automated production.

ratings.reason: Industrial workers are intended to gain automation skills and problem-solving capability.
Manufacturers and trainers are intended to improve onboarding and reduce rework; no observed result is supplied.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
